report.clinical_summary: Patient reports significant functional impairment, with days where they can barely get out of bed. They describe the illness as having taken over their work, family time, hobbies, career goals, and parts of their personality. They understand their condition as a chronic immune system issue with their body constantly battling infection. Treatment with medication has shown clear benefit (viral load dropped, CD4 count stable), but they experience side effects (headaches in afternoon/evening after food) that interfere with dinner and bedtime routines. They are actively managing side effects with gentle stretches and considering dietary changes. They feel isolated and believe their life has been put on hold, though they are thinking proactively about gradually rebuilding some routine activities.
